testo:
■ When you put this field, put the top card of your deck into your mana zone tapped.
■ Each of your Dragons get "speed attacker". (A creature that has "speed attacker" doesn't get summoning sickness".)
■ Ultra Saver: Dragon (When one of your Dragons would leave, you may destroy this field instead.)
